newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George welcomes UK monetary appointees.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George welcomes UK monetary appointees.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Monday he was "delighted" with the four outside appointees to Britain's new monetary policy committee.
Earlier, Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown appointed Professor Charles Goodhart, Dr DeAnne Julius, Sir Alan Budd and Professor Willem Buiter to sit on the monetary committee.
They will sit alongside four members from the Bank of England, led by by Governor Eddie George, until the appointment of a second deputy governor to the Bank takes its number to five.
"I am delighted with the four outside members nominated by the Chancellor," George said in a statement.
"I believe that they will make a major contribution to the quality of the Bank's monetary analysis and to the authority of our monetary policy judgements," he said.
He also welcomed the appointment of Christopher Allsopp to the Bank's Court, to which the committee will be accountable.
The Treasury said Allsopp, of Oxford University, had been appointed in order to strengthen the capacity of the Court to exercise that role.
